title: Magnitude-weighted cardiac asymmetry does not establish incremental age transfer beyond count asymmetry and standard HRV
abstract: Squared-increment RR asymmetry (Guzik index) did not establish incremental age-group prediction beyond count asymmetry and conventional HRV in two public collections. Fantasia-to-NSR2 logloss gain was -0.007770 (source-refit 95% interval [-0.076156, 0.042487]); reverse gain was -0.004186 [-0.099552, 0.054016], with unchanged AUC in both directions. This exploratory negative result is not equivalence; participant overlap is unknown and no untouched confirmation was available.
